name: CubingUSA Western FMC Championship 2023
information: ![West Coast Cubing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc29SIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e561d0a9c0d6249576e169bfde3e7dbcbf20fe23/wcc-banner.png) - This competition is in partnership with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) - This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. - This competition exists to crown the Western Champion of FMC for 2023! For a more normal comeptition experience, or additional details, check out [CubingUSA Western Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingUSAWesternChampionship2023) - Podiums and champions from this competition will be recognized at CubingUSA Western Championship 2023 during the award ceremony there. - This competition will take place at different venues across Northern and Southern California. If you are potentially unable to reach these locales, we would highly recommend refraining from registering from this competition. - Check out the Location Tab for more details.
